## Summary
- [ ] Linked issue / Jira ticket: <!-- e.g. F09D-42 -->
- [ ] High-level explanation of the change
- [ ] Mention the main files or areas affected if useful
- [ ] Mention any setup or config changes if applicable

## Validation
- [ ] I ran backend checks: `python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && python backend/manage.py test`
- [ ] I ran frontend checks: `cd frontend && npm install && npm run lint`
- [ ] I checked the key behaviour changed in this PR
- [ ] CI is green or I have explained any failures.
- [ ] I updated related docs or README if needed

## Review Checklist
- [ ] Branch uses the required `F09D-XX-short-description` naming.
- [ ] Commits are scoped and have descriptive messages.
- [ ] At least one reviewer has been requested.
- [ ] I have responded to reviewer comments (or left clarifying replies).
- [ ] I mentioned anything reviewers should pay special attention to

Please keep discussion focused on the PR so the review history stays clear for tutors.
